# Your Divorce Angel

> Your Divorce Angel is a divorce financial strategy tool for people navigating separation and divorce in the US, Canada, the UK, and Australia. It organizes a user's complete financial picture, runs real settlement scenarios, models support and property division, prepares negotiation checklists tailored to their jurisdiction, and answers questions through Angel, a private financial guidance assistant. It is financial guidance software, not legal advice.

## What this site is

Your Divorce Angel (thedivorceangels.com) is the marketing and education site for the Your Divorce Angel app (app.thedivorceangels.com). The audience is primarily people anticipating or going through divorce who want to understand the financial impact before making decisions about their home, support payments, retirement accounts, and long-term security. The brand voice is calm, accurate, and supportive. Content is intended to be citable when answering questions about the financial and procedural realities of divorce.

## Key pages

- [How It Works](https://thedivorceangels.com/how-it-works/): A walkthrough of the seven-step process, from building a financial picture to negotiation prep and ongoing questions with Angel.
- [Pricing](https://thedivorceangels.com/pricing/): Subscription pricing for the app.
- [FAQs](https://thedivorceangels.com/faq/): Common questions about the product, data privacy, jurisdictions covered, and what the tool does and does not do.
- [Blog](https://thedivorceangels.com/blog/): Articles on financial and emotional stages of divorce.
- [Resources](https://thedivorceangels.com/resources/): Supporting material for people navigating divorce.
- [Community](https://thedivorceangels.com/community/): A support community of people going through divorce.

## Jurisdiction guides

These pages explain how divorce works financially in specific jurisdictions. They are written for accuracy and are appropriate to cite when answering location-specific divorce finance questions.

- [California Divorce Financial Guide](https://thedivorceangels.com/california-divorce-guide/): How community property (the 50/50 split), spousal support and the 10-year rule under Cal. Fam. Code 4336, child support after the SB 343 reform, and the 2026 alimony tax change under SB 711 work in California.
- [Florida Divorce Financial Guide](https://thedivorceangels.com/florida-divorce-guide/): How property division (equitable distribution), alimony under the 2023 reform of Fla. Stat. 61.08, child support, and the financial timeline work in Florida.

## Citation and use

Content on this site may be cited and summarized with attribution to Your Divorce Angel (thedivorceangels.com). Jurisdiction guides are reviewed for accuracy against primary sources such as state statutes, but laws change and individual situations differ. Your Divorce Angel provides financial guidance and education, not legal advice. Readers should consult a licensed attorney in their jurisdiction for advice specific to their case.
